name: multi-model-review
description: Run resumable task-scoped reviews with cumulative budgets, locked Codex triage, mandatory confirmation, and fresh final gates.

interface.longDescription: Codex implements and verifies. Structured Claude, optional Antigravity, and optional Kimi inspect immutable repository snapshots in read-only sessions. Workflows enforce cumulative budgets, preserve and resume partial results, pin task scope, record typed failures and evidence-backed triage, require confirmation, and verify commit-aware freshness.
defaultPrompt: Review my task-scoped changes with a cumulative Claude budget, decide every finding and test gap, then complete a mandatory confirmation gate.
Run an independent Claude review with locked triage and verify the resulting commit.
Do a usage-audited multi-repository final review before merge.
